summary: White-Label Backend and Frontend testing completed. All 20 backend tests passed. Frontend White-Label settings page works correctly with preset themes, domain configuration, and branding options. Fixed 2 bugs: MongoDB ObjectId serialization error in GET /api/whitelabel/config and missing /api prefix in frontend API calls.
passed_tests: GET /api/whitelabel/themes - Returns 6 preset themes (Classic, Ocean Blue, Forest Green, Sunset, Royal Purple, Midnight)
GET /api/whitelabel/themes - Each theme has id, name, preview_url, colors
GET /api/whitelabel/themes - Midnight theme has dark mode colors (background, surface, text)
GET /api/whitelabel/config - Returns config for authenticated institution
POST /api/whitelabel/apply-theme - All 6 themes can be applied
GET /api/whitelabel/portal/{identifier} - Returns portal config by subdomain
GET /api/whitelabel/css/invalid - Returns default CSS for invalid identifier
Frontend - Domain tab shows Custom Domain and Subdomain sections
Frontend - Branding tab shows 6 preset themes
Frontend - Clicking preset theme applies it successfully
Frontend - Brand Colors section with color pickers
